description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for Würth Elektronik's WSEN PADS sensor, implementing sensor data fetching, configuration, and initialization.

methods.name: pads_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches pressure and temperature samples from the sensor.

methods.name: pads_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to sensor_value format for specific channels.

methods.name: pads_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the sensor.

methods.name: pads_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes, primarily sampling frequency.

methods.name: pads_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, including interface setup and configuration.
